newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says Havre subsidiaries licenses withdrawn.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says Havre subsidiaries licenses withdrawn.

text.p: Mexico's Finance Ministry announced Tuesday it had withdrawn operating licences for two subsidiaries of the bankrupt Grupo Financiero Havre.

Licenses for Havre's factoring and leasing arms were withdrawn "due to the bankruptcy proceedings taking place against them, without there being any possibility of their recovering," the Finance Ministry said in the Mexican Government's official gazette.

The Finance Ministry intervened in both companies on May 25, 1994, following irregularities that made them technically bankrupt. The companies were declared bankrupt in September 1994, and proceedings to remove their licenses began earlier this year.
